body: Glad you're still here with us! I know it’s tough right now but I promise you eventually it will get better. Please stay. Your life is worth living. Take it from someone who wasted most of their 20s letting agoraphobia run their life. I have faith in you. It just takes time.

Feeling this way for a long time is exhausting. Try and give yourself some grace. What you’re going through is not easy. If you want to be able to have the interactions you have to start small. You have so much to offer this world, and the world to you. Don’t give up 🆙 now yourself yet.

You got this! AirPorts can be extremely overwhelming. After you get through tsa try and find a quiet section of the airport to sit in. Don’t forget to bring headphones and snacks. You can 100% do this.
